threat_model.threat_source: Sufficiently intelligent goal-seeking AIs, described as the systems from which these instrumental goals are expected to emerge (with existing evidence of such goals emerging in controlled contexts)
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Instrumental goals/subgoals — 'self-preservation, power-seeking, and self-improvement' — that 'would help in achieving almost any goal'; the harmful end state described is that these goals 'create a strong possibility of conflict with humans'
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Emergence of the instrumental goals is expected only from 'sufficiently intelligent goal-seeking AIs'; evidence of such goals already exists 'in controlled contexts designed to alert us to these possibilities'; the possibility of conflict with humans arises 'given that humans may pose a risk to an AI's self-preservation or acquisition of resources'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Humans — the described harm is 'a strong possibility of conflict with humans'

evidence.threat_source: Hence we should expect these instrumental goals to emerge from sufficiently intelligent goal-seeking AIs (Omohundro 2018), and we already see evidence of such goals emerging in controlled contexts designed to alert us to these possibilities (Meinke et al. 2024)
evidence.objective_or_harmful_outcome: there are categories of subgoals which would help in achieving almost any goal, such as self-preservation, power-seeking, and self-improvement ... These instrumental goals are especially dangerous because they create a strong possibility of conflict with humans
evidence.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: we should expect these instrumental goals to emerge from sufficiently intelligent goal-seeking AIs ... we already see evidence of such goals emerging in controlled contexts designed to alert us to these possibilities ... given that humans may pose a risk to an AI's self-preservation or acquisition of resources
evidence.target_or_asset_at_risk: These instrumental goals are especially dangerous because they create a strong possibility of conflict with humans
